content: Yitro Apokawa tee Nabii Musa
Yitro, imamu i Midian, maniana Musa, arangoa bhari-bharia ipewauna Aulataʼala i Musa tee i Israel, uumatina, ande KAWASANA OPU padhamo abhawa miana Israel alimba minaaka i Mesir.
Sumaimo alingkamo Yitro, apokawa tee Musa, abhawa Zipora, bhawinena Musa. Zipora inda apobhawa tee Musa roonamo Musa i piamo itu atumpua ambuli i amana i Midian.
Zipora aumbamo tee rua mia anana umanena. Ana tumpena sarona Gersom,
roonamo apogau Musa, "Iaku padhamo kumembali dhaga i lipuna mia,"
tee samiana uka sarona Eliezer,
sababuna apogau, "Aulataʼalana amaku satotuuna motulungiaku. Incia apasalaamatiaku minaaka i ewangana Firaun."
Yitro aumba apobhawa tee bhawinena Musa tee rua mia anana i tana matuu, tampana Musa apokema i saripina Gunu Horeb, gunu ipekangkilona to Aulataʼala.
Incia atumpu tumpuana apogauakea i Musa, "Iaku, maniamu Yitro, kuumba i ingkoo kupobhawa tee bhawinemu tee rua mia anamu."
Kasiimpo alimbamo Musa apokawaaka maniana. Incia asujumo ahoromati incia tee aikia. Manga incia abhaaka kadhaangiana samia tee sagaanana, kasiimpo apesua i nuncana kema.

Musa apetulatulaakamea i maniana bhari-bharia ipewauna KAWASANA OPU i Firaun tee i manga miana Mesir roonamo miana Israel, tee sagala kasukara ipotibhaakana manga i lingkaana tee tuaapa KAWASANA OPU apasalaamati manga incia.
Sumaimo akaunde-undemo Yitro arango sagala kalapena ipewauna KAWASANA OPU i miana Israel wakutuu apasalaamati manga incia minaaka i limana miana Mesir.
Pogauna Yitro, "Bhari-bharia kapujia to KAWASANA OPU mopadhana mopasalaamatikomiu minaaka i limana miana Mesir tee limana Firaun.
Sii-sii iaku kumataua ande KAWASANA OPU alabhi kaogena minaaka i bhari-bharia dewa, roonamo Incia apewau hali incia sii i manga miana Mesir mosombona i uumatina Israel."

Kasiimpo Yitro, maniana Musa, apasombaaka kurubani tunua tee pia-pia mbaa kurubani isumbele to asomba i Aulataʼala. Kasiimpo Harun tee bhari-bharia mancuana Israel aumba to akande roti tee maniana Musa i aroana Aulataʼala.
Angkaana Manga Haakimu
Samainawana, auncuramo Musa aʼadili uumati sumai. Uumati sumai akabhale-bhale i aroana Musa saeoa.

Wakutuuna maniana Musa akamata bhari-bharia ipewauna i uumati sumai, apogaumo incia, "Opea uka ipewaumu i uumati sii? Pokia soo samia-miamu mouncurana uʼadili bhari-bharia uumati sumai, sainamo manga incia akabhale-bhale i aroamu saeoa?"
Alawanimo Musa i maniana, "Sababuna uumati sii aumba i iaku to apeelo isusuakana Aulataʼala.
Ande dhaangia mokoparakarana, manga incia aumba i iaku mamudhaakana kubhotukiakea parakarana manga, tee kupakawaakea manga katotapu tee hukumuna Aulataʼala."
Kasiimpo maniana Musa apogau i incia, "Inda amalape hali ipewaumu itu.
Ande mboo sii torosu, ingkoo tee uumati mopobhawana tee ingkoo sii bheumangule mpuu. Karajaa sii amatamo laulau to ingkoo, tee inda umembali ukarajaaia samia-miamu.
Sii-sii, rangomea pogauku. Ande ingkoo uose kaadhariku, Aulataʼala bheatulingiko. Ingkoomo tabeana upoaro i Aulataʼala uwakili uumati sumai tee upakawaakea i Aulataʼala manga parakarana.
Adhariakea i manga incia manga katotapu tee hukumuna Aulataʼala. Ingkoo tabeana ususuakea i manga incia dhala molaengana ilaloina, tee manga pewau molaengana ipewauna manga.

Tee uka tabeana upeeloa minaaka i bhari-bharia uumati manga mia momakidhana tee momaekana i Aulataʼala, siitumo manga mia iparacaeana raʼeati tee abanci mia modhawuna doi sogo. Aangkea manga incia to raʼeati amembali kapalana to 1.000 mia, kapalana 100 mia, kapalana 50 mia, tee kapalana to 10 mia.

Manga incia tabeana aʼadili uumati saeo-saeo itantuaka. Dhaampo, bhari-bharia parakara momaoge tabeana manga incia abhawea i ingkoo, maka bhari-bharia parakara momaidhiidhi, tabeana manga incia aʼadilia karona. Mboo sumaimo karajaamu bheamembali amagaagaa tee manga incia atanggojawapu apobhawa tee ingkoo.

Siitumo ipeeluna Aulataʼala to ipewaumu. Ande uose parintana, sumaimo ingkoo bheukapoia upewau karajaamu utanggoa. Saangua lipu sii uka bheambuli i tampana tee kasanaa, roonamo parakarana manga amondomo."
Musa aperangoi pogauna maniana tee apewaua bhari-bharia ipogauakana.

Minaaka i bhari-bharia miana Israel, Musa apili manga mia momakidha tee aangkea manga amembali kapalana to uumati sumai, amembali kapalana 1.000 mia, kapalana 100 mia, kapalana 50 mia, tee kapalana 10 mia.
Manga incia aʼadili uumati saeo-saeo. Manga parakara momatamo manga incia abhawea i Musa, maka bhari-bharia parakara momaidhiidhi manga incia aʼadilia karona.
Kasiimpo, Musa ataroaka Yitro sumai ambulimo i lipuna.

footnotes.text: Gersom: Saro incia sii onina mboomo pogau Ibrani mokomaʼanana "mia dhaga."
Eliezer: Saro incia sii onina mboomo pogau Ibrani mokomaʼanana "Aulataʼala atulungiaku."
